route.reading: After roughly 3–5 miles, reach the broken road on the ascent; the caravan wreck is downslope about a quarter to half a mile away. Bandits investigate it while party discussion continues.
The village ruins are described another roughly five miles up the road; continue uphill to the village. The abandoned mines farther back are proposed for later exploration and are not visited.

markers.note: The distances given on approach are approximate route descriptions, not measured total travel distance. The earlier forecast of reaching the hills before darkness does not establish an elapsed duration.
